mapper.select: SELECT employee_id FROM hr_final_settlement WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND settlement_id = #{settlementId}

SELECT settlement.settlement_id, settlement.employee_id, employee.user_id, user_row.user_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.employeeName')) AS employee_name, employee.dept_id, department.dept_name, settlement.settlement_no, settlement.net_amount AS amount, settlement.status, settlement.approval_status, settlement.instance_id, settlement.payment_request_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.approval.applicantUserId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS submitter_user_id FROM hr_final_settlement settlement JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND employee.id = settlement.employee_id AND employee.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user user_row ON user_row.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND user_row.user_id = employee.user_id AND user_row.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_dept department ON department.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND department.dept_id = employee.dept_id AND department.deleted = 0 WHERE settlement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND settlement.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND ((settlement.settlement_kind = 'NORMAL' AND settlement.reversal_of_id IS NULL AND (settlement.superseded_flag = 0 OR (settlement.superseded_flag = 1 AND settlement.status IN ('PAID','CLOSED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_final_settlement returned WHERE returned.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND returned.reversal_of_id = settlement.settlement_id AND returned.settlement_kind = 'REVERSAL' AND returned.employee_id = settlement.employee_id AND returned.lifecycle_application_id = settlement.lifecycle_application_id AND returned.net_amount = -settlement.net_amount AND returned.status IN ('PAID','CLOSED') AND returned.paid_time IS NOT NULL)))) OR (settlement.settlement_kind = 'REVERSAL' AND settlement.superseded_flag = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_final_settlement original WHERE original.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND original.settlement_id = settlement.reversal_of_id AND original.settlement_kind = 'NORMAL' AND original.reversal_of_id IS NULL AND original.employee_id = settlement.employee_id AND original.lifecycle_application_id = settlement.lifecycle_application_id AND original.net_amount = -settlement.net_amount AND original.status IN ('PAID','CLOSED') AND original.paid_time IS NOT NULL AND (original.superseded_flag = 0 OR (original.superseded_flag = 1 AND settlement.status IN ('PAID','CLOSED')))))) AND settlement.confirmed_time IS NOT NULL AND settlement.confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.employeeUserId')) = CAST(employee.user_id AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.deptId')) = CAST(employee.dept_id AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.direction')) = 'PAYMENT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.employeeName')) = 'STRING' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.confirmation.netAmount')) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) = settlement.net_amount AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_employee duplicate_employee WHERE duplicate_employee.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND duplicate_employee.user_id = employee.user_id AND duplicate_employee.deleted = 0 AND duplicate_employee.id != employee.id) FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_final_settlement settlement JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND instance.instance_id = settlement.instance_id WHERE settlement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND settlement.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND settlement.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND instance.status = 'PASSED' AND instance.deleted = 0 AND instance.business_key = CONCAT('HR_SETTLEMENT:', settlement.settlement_id, ':R', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.revision'))) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessType')) = 'HR_SETTLEMENT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessId')) = CAST(settlement.settlement_id AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.decision')) = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_callback_side_effect effect WHERE effect.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND effect.business_type = 'HR_SETTLEMENT' AND effect.business_id = settlement.settlement_id AND effect.process_instance_id = instance.instance_id AND effect.effect_key = 'SETTLEMENT_DECISION') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND history.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND history.action = 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE' AND history.task_type = 'OR_SIGN' AND history.node_key = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.approval.financeNodeId')) AND CAST(history.operator_id AS CHAR) = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.decisionActor')) AND history.operator_id != instance.start_user_id AND CAST(history.operator_id AS CHAR) != JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(settlement.calculation_snapshot, '$.workflow.approval.settlementEmployeeUserId')) AND history.on_behalf_of_user_id IS NULL AND history.create_time IS NOT NULL)
SELECT * FROM biz_payment_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_biz_type = 'HR_SETTLEMENT' AND source_biz_id = #{settlementId}
